note.en: Task and vision accuracy were not evaluated; the 262K window was not admitted within the test budget and hardware telemetry has a 46-minute gap. Sample sizes vary by point.

notes.zh: 133000 总窗口六路满长驻留、零抢占（N=12）。Agent C4 共 437 轮传输有效，436 轮有最终回复；工具控制和截断仍有边界。
notes.en: Six full-window requests resided without preemption at a 133,000-token window (N=12). Agent C4 had 437 transport-valid turns and 436 final responses; tool control and truncation remain limitations.
